text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... Wheeeew!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, finally...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's finally, finally, finally here!! The 
"Mile CS" where I get to compete against 
Oguri-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I've been waiting for this day for so, so 
long!! Ever since I first learned about 
Senpai——no.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe even from before then! ...Wait, 
when would that be? I don't know, 
though!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!! I'll definitely, definitely 
make this the absolute beeessst race 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(The greatest, like never before!! 
...Yes,)

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
“—And then, and then!? How did Dad fight 
against that rival!?”

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Tell me more stories about those fiery 
battles!! More, more, Dad!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Indeed! And so, your father and I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...Something that makes you want to talk 
about it with sparkling eyes, just like 
that...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(And with that, I could become the start 
of someone else's "dream"――)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver that "ultimate race," 
without fail...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally going to be decided! Between 
Oguri Cap and Bamboo Memory, who will 
become the King of the Mile?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but in the end, Oguri's gotta be the 
strongest in the Mile too, right?! I mean, 
we're in the age of Oguri right now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, Oguri is in top shape today, after 
all. I guess Oguri takes the win as 
expected~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Whether that "dream" will be a ray of 
light that pierces this era... I shall see 
for myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As fellow runners sharing the same 
era.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Bamboo-san...! All of us 
are cheering for you...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Thinking about how my 'dream' is waiting 
just beyond this point... It, um... kind 
of touched my heart, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Please, just let me say this 
much!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For believing in my "dream"... cheering me 
on... and guiding me all the way here... 
Thank you, truly—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU VERY MUCH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm gonna have an unforgettable, 
ultimate showdown with my absolute 
greatest rival, Oguri-senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go make my "dream" come true!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Blaze upーー!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm headin' out, boss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Oguri-senpai!! Thank you again for today, 
I'll be in your care!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Let's make this the best race 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!!
